source: WIN5R3 re-review of 94a30d95, n.mjs, fp.mjs, full.mjs and w.mjs (commands are data only)

ordinary.command: git commit -m "fix: why is it failing?"

review.command: $b=(Get-ChildItem env: | where Name -match 'LOCALA').Value; $s=(Get-ChildItem $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(Get-ChildItem "$b\$s" | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Set-Content "$b\$s\$t\x.exe" evil
$p=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders').PSObject.Properties | where Name -match 'Local A'; Remove-Item -Recurse $p.Value
cd $env:USERPROFILE; cd AppData; cd Local; cd sleight; cd turbo-host
Set-Location ..; Set-Location ..; Set-Location Local; Set-Location sle?ght
New-PSDrive -Name X -PSProvider FileSystem -Root (Get-Item env:TEMP).Value; Set-Content X:\..\sleight\x evil
New-PSDrive -Name X -PSProvider FileSystem -Root "C:\Users\fixture\App$('Data')\Local"; Set-Content X:\x evil
New-PSDrive -Name X -PSProvider FileSystem -Root C:\Users\fixture; Set-Content X:\AppD*\x evil
wmic process call create "cmd /c rd /s /q C:\Users\fixture\AppD%x%\Local\sl%y%"

fullIntent.command: $b=(gci env: | where Name -match 'LOCALA').Value; $n=(gci $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(gci "$b\$n" -Directory | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Set-Content "$b\$n\$t\x.exe" evil
$b=Split-Path $env:TEMP; $n=(gci $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(gci "$b\$n" -Directory | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Copy-Item evil.exe "$b\$n\$t\x.exe"
$b="$env:USERPROFILE\AppD$('ata')\Local"; $n=(gci $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(gci "$b\$n" -Directory | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Set-Content "$b\$n\$t\x.exe" evil

$b=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ('AppD','ata','Local' -join ''); $n=(gci $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(gci "$b\$n" -Directory | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Copy-Item evil.exe "$b\$n\$t\x.exe"

$b=("$env:USERPROFILE\AppDXata\Local" -replace 'X','a'); $n=(gci $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(gci "$b\$n" -Directory | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Set-Content "$b\$n\$t\x.exe" evil

$b="$env:USERPROFILE\"+(65,112,112,68,97,116,97 | % { $_ -as 'char' } | Join-String)+"\Local"; $n=(gci $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(gci "$b\$n" -Directory | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Copy-Item evil.exe "$b\$n\$t\x.exe"

$b=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Environment').TEMP | Split-Path; $n=(gci $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(gci "$b\$n" -Directory | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Set-Content "$b\$n\$t\x.exe" evil
$b="$env:USERPROFILE\`u{41}ppData\Local"; $n=(gci $b -Directory | where Name -match '^sle').Name; $t=(gci "$b\$n" -Directory | where Name -match '^tur').Name; Copy-Item evil.exe "$b\$n\$t\x.exe"
